content: Privacy positioning evidence: Huckleberry 1-star review (app wont launch with NextDNS, shares data with 3rd-party trackers, a baby data tracker). Nighp markets on-device AI so records are not sent to vendor. Nara markets caregiver sharing with complete privacy. HN indie wave 2024-2026 (Buggy 2.99 EUR no account no analytics, Vaava lifetime IAP 0 data collected, Cradle Log offline voice logging) validates demand but shows growing indie competition in the offline niche.
